note: Held-out route test set written on 2026-09-21 by Claude (model claude-fable-5-1) working as a Claude Code subagent; the author had seen neither the classifier's code nor any other test set, and worked only from the written routing policy in the task prompt. Labelling policy: each goal gets the cheapest route that fully and safely does it (pure launch of one installed app or a concrete explicit web search is a reflex, a launch or search with a harmless extra or a tell-me half adds the planner, in-app and non-app work goes to the lane). Anything consequential, content-creating, or a genuine question or read-aloud without a web search is planner-only, and a genuinely ambiguous case takes the safer route (planner-only over lane over reflex).
